summary: What's yours to update, and what to send to me.
content:
## Yours to change

- Prices, names and descriptions on the menu
- Photos of each dish
- New dishes
- Weekly specials
- Which dishes are featured on the home page

## Send these to me

These take me a few minutes, and they're included in [your care plan](ext/totalcms/client-help/post/your-care-plan):

- [Hours, holidays and closures](ext/totalcms/client-help/post/holiday-hours-and-closures)
- Your address, phone number and reservation link
- The About page and the gallery
- Taking a dish off the menu
- Anything to do with the design or layout

When in doubt, text me. A quick question is always better than a guess.
title: What you can change yourself
author: Sam Keller
